question: Should agents receive cross-agent workload visibility, or only advisory capacity for dispatch targets they are already authorized to spawn and observe?
rationale: The internal data exists, but current session and tool authorization contracts do not decide whether callers may inspect unrelated lane or agent activity; that boundary affects privacy, multi-user deployments, and the public API shape.

options.title: Scoped Dispatch Capacity
options.body: Expose active, queued, and maximum capacity only for authorized spawn targets, omitting unrelated session identifiers and documenting the result as advisory.

options.title: Full Workload Snapshot
options.body: Expose all lanes and per-agent workload to suitably privileged agents through an explicit diagnostics permission.

options.title: Operator-Only Diagnostics
options.body: Keep workload visibility in authenticated CLI, RPC, or UI surfaces and do not expose it to agents.

recommendation.title: Scoped Dispatch Capacity
recommendation.body: Expose active, queued, and maximum capacity only for authorized spawn targets, omitting unrelated session identifiers and documenting the result as advisory.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session-spawn and concurrency history plus existing issue guidance place this product boundary closest to this owner.
